$comment: Code-coverage exclusions under SIGNOFF.md section 4. Each names the instance, the signals, one of the allowed codes, the reason and the approver; the BITS ARE A RULE over the spec (exclusion_rules.py), never a literal list, so the same file holds for every spec: apply_exclusions.py derives the bits against the spec and the drop under judgement and records what it derived. The approval covers the rule. Nothing here changes what the simulator measures.

exclusions.reason: The three low column bits are the burst offset within a BL8 burst (spec memory_geometry.burst_length = 8); the address decoder issues every column aligned to the burst, so these bits are constant 0 at the controller. The queue stores them because the port width is the full column.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 on the validation subsystem owner's review: the bits are constant by the spec's burst alignment, not by lack of stimulus.

exclusions.reason: Same bits as X-001 seen from the scheduler: the queue entries' column and the issued command's column carry a burst-aligned column, low three bits constant under burst_length = 8.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 on the validation subsystem owner's review: the bits are constant by the spec's burst alignment, not by lack of stimulus.

exclusions.reason: The reset input rises once per simulation and never falls again; the init paths' assertions cover reset behaviour. A fall toggle would need a second reset, which no path applies.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 on the validation subsystem owner's review: no path applies a second reset; the init paths' assertions judge reset behaviour. Retires itself if a mid-run reset path is added (the bit then toggles).

exclusions.reason: 8-bit timing counter(s) sized for any speed grade; this spec loads at most 11 (tRCD_nCK/tRP_nCK, timing_model.$derived_cycles) and the counter decrements once per controller clock (timing_model.counter_clock), so bits 4 and up can never be set.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 after the uncovered-item review of the four blocks under 90 %.
exclusions.$rule_note: tRCD and tRP share one rule (tRCD_nCK); they are equal on every JEDEC DDR3 speed bin.

exclusions.reason: 8-bit timing counter(s) sized for any speed grade; this spec loads at most 12 (tWR_nCK, timing_model.$derived_cycles) and the counter decrements once per controller clock (timing_model.counter_clock), so bits 4 and up can never be set.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 after the uncovered-item review of the four blocks under 90 %.

exclusions.reason: 8-bit timing counter(s) sized for any speed grade; this spec loads at most 6 (tRRD_nCK/tRTP_nCK/tCCD_nCK, timing_model.$derived_cycles) and the counter decrements once per controller clock (timing_model.counter_clock), so bits 3 and up can never be set.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 after the uncovered-item review of the four blocks under 90 %.
exclusions.$rule_note: tRRD_nCK, tRTP_nCK and tCCD_nCK are all 6 or less on every DDR3 speed bin's derived cycles here; the rule takes tRRD (the largest of the three in this spec). If a spec made tRTP or tCCD larger than tRRD, split the entry.

exclusions.reason: CL countdown in controller cycles: ceil(CL_cycles/clock_ratio) - 1 = 2 for CL = 11 at 4:1; an 8-bit counter sized for any CL.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 after the uncovered-item review of the four blocks under 90 %.

exclusions.reason: CWL countdown in controller cycles: ceil(CWL_cycles/clock_ratio) - 1 = 1 for CWL = 8 at 4:1.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 after the uncovered-item review of the four blocks under 90 %.

exclusions.reason: Beat counters for a host word of 2 channel beats (data_path_mapping.pack_mode): values 0..1; the 2-bit counter allows 4.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 after the uncovered-item review of the four blocks under 90 %.

exclusions.reason: CTRL_CONFIG bits 8:31 are 'reserved', access RO, in the spec's register map: they read as zero and no write reaches them.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 after the uncovered-item review of the four blocks under 90 %.

exclusions.reason: BIST_ADDR_START/END bits 31:29 are 'reserved', access RO: the address is 29 bits (host_interface.address_width_bits).
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 after the uncovered-item review of the four blocks under 90 %.

exclusions.reason: Register offsets are word-aligned (32-bit registers, bits 1:0 constant) and the map ends at offset 0x28 (11 registers), so bits 7:6 are never set by a mapped access; unmapped offsets are judged by the error response, not by toggling address bits.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 after the uncovered-item review of the four blocks under 90 %.

exclusions.reason: Status inputs of config_regs that no block in this design drives: there is no BIST engine, no ECC unit and no self-refresh controller among the 11 blocks (the integration map lists no source and no tie for these ports; the harness leaves them at zero). The register bits they feed can only change when such a block exists; the CSR access semantics of those bits are judged by the register walk.
exclusions.decision_note: Approved 2026-10-29 after the uncovered-item review of the four blocks under 90 %.
